interface.name: wsx_opaque_buffer_manager_v1

description.summary: paired WSX opaque PRIME buffer import

interface.description: Private extension, not a DRM modifier or linux-dmabuf layout. Each fd must refer to a real PRIME GEM object with an immutable WSX descriptor registered by the paired kernel and native owner. The server verifies dimensions, format, allocation identity and generation before creating a wl_buffer. No stride is transmitted because optimal layouts have no linear pitch. The resulting wl_buffer uses ordinary surface attach/commit, buffer release and linux-drm-syncobj synchronization. This extension adds no copy path.

arg.name: fd
arg.summary: real PRIME fd; ownership transfers to the server
